notes.title: Somber Echoes content update and news
notes.notes:
[p]July 8th, marks the release of Somber Echoes on Playstation and Xbox, but also a significant milestone in our post-release efforts. We would like to seize the opportunity to thank every single one of our players for your constructive feedback and encouraging words. [/p][p][/p][p]Paying close attention to your feedback, we focused our efforts on addressing the most reported concerns in the update that was released on June 27th, and the one update that we are releasing today. We are also introducing some extra content that we hope will satisfy those among you that enjoy an extra challenge.[/p][p][/p][p]As a reminder, the highlights of our previous patch are:[/p][list][*][p]District outlines, traveling between all rest shrines and an item locator feature to make finding your way around the Atromitos even easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to lantern traversal and the Supernova ability that make exploration smoother and even more enjoyable.
[/p][/*][/list][p]With our Playstation and Xbox release, all versions of Somber Echoes are receiving the following additional content in the form of challenges:[/p][list][*][p][b]Speedrun modes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Make your way to and defeat the Phoenix boss[/p][/*][*][p]Start from scratch and get to the final boss[/p][/*][*][p]With a full loadout and every door unlocked from the start, hunt down and defeat all bosses[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss challenges[/b][/p][list][*][p]Varying difficulty boss fights with a predetermined loadouts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Supernova puzzles[/b][/p][list][*][p]7 traversal puzzles that will challenge you problem solving skills as well as your mastery of the Supernova mechanic
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeIEZinkCJ4yQQQLQZ3HePpkGvNmA1GUPw9uFWgtgM9OCt55O1DLpVsxFS6nYS5K0wmBImYLkMsiEm3J_zvPn2IngGW0joqzmLaa65PXehUEjXOOo-KvwmvitlGwNQw-tuwGBpMhA?key=ffz4x7ugyh_ZRHYGPjkyfg"][/img][/p][p]Each of the challenges have varying unlocking conditions that vary from reaching a specific point in the game, or defeating a certain boss, to finishing the whole game once.[/p][p][/p][h2]Journal[/h2][p]Our initial intention with the presentation of the narrative in Somber Echoes was to keep it somewhat discreet and elusive, requiring players that cared for it to pay some attention to figure out what had happened. At the same time it would be out of the way for more action oriented players.[/p][p][/p][p]Reacting to your feedback about the story being too elusive, we are adding a brand new inventory tab called Journal. It keeps track of all important storylines and also provides context in the form of Adrestia’s insights into the evolving narrative. 
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdsmJ8wLHTFfJVtZq7UmrGUoJ2l6RzrygHoc2fAVIBIXO8igZSgE2JZkirOJnwEXRBij0ubgufppBYiHwip6pVxLbgTL8-cO386SukoOcolSDcBu11qtVXZCHqV8sueOSUPeSUkLw?key=ffz4x7ugyh_ZRHYGPjkyfg"][/img][/p][p]Journal nodes are filled in as you progress through the game and discover narrative moments. Each node may have various story tidbits associated with it, which will be linked together, to give you the complete picture of what has happened, and what Adrestia’s reaction to the unfolding events is. The journal can be opened at any time to serve as an overview of where the story has taken you so far, or to jog your memory about a specific narrative point.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you will enjoy the new challenges and that the fixes and additions of the latest two patches address your most prominent feedback. We remain devoted to acting on your continued feedback to make Somber Echoes the best it can be.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you![/b] [/p]

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Update #7 - June 2025
notes.notes: [h3]Map system updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Powering up any of the Circe Chambers will reveal the outline of the entire district that the chamber is associated with.[/p][/*][*][p]Added two new Circe Chambers one for the Cesspit and one for the Higher Residence district.[/p][/*][*][p]An item locator feature has been added to the Circe Chambers functionality:[/p][list][*][p]To activate the feature you need to power up the Circe Chamber close to the end of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Once activated, the Item Locator will be available to all Circe Chambers.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Circe Chamber reveals the location of Upgrade materials, Survivors, Nyx Fragments and Necklace Pieces within the district it belongs to.[/p][/*][*][p]Locating an item through this feature incurs a fixed Favor cost per item.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Fast Travel updates:[/h3][list][*][p]Adrestia can now fast travel between any discovered shrines with the following condition:[/p][list][*][p]To fast travel to and from any shrine, you must have activated the Circe Chamber for both the origin and destination districts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Lantern traversal updates:[/h3][list][*][p]The collision when exiting an Aether Lantern has been improved:[/p][list][*][p]This will result in less unwanted collisions with level corners and ledges when using the lantern to traverse the levels.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The “grace period” and conditions for exiting the Supernova state has been made more generous:[/p][list][*][p]When you hit a surface head on while in the Supernova State, Adrestia will remain in the state for longer, allowing you a longer time to react.[/p][/*][*][p]When you hit a surface at a very shallow angle while in the Supernova State, the vector of your trajectory will be made parallel to the surface, allowing for nailing puzzles that stretch for long distances more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]In general these changes should make our more challenging puzzles a bit more manageable and less frustrating.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]System:[/h3][list][*][p]Added an option to adjust the timing of damage received [/p][list][*][p]This change is mainly aimed at TV or other slower refresh rate/higher latency monitor players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam cloud save enabled - Disclaimer
notes.notes:
Steam cloud save is now enabled. 
Make sure you update to the latest update: 10.feb - 2025 or newer, as that added support.

[b]A disclaimer for players using multiple computers/steam decks, etc.[/b]
To ensure you do not loose any progress, make sure you start the game on the platform you wish to keep the save from.
For extra safety, creating a local backup of the save files could be smart. 

Save files can be found here:
Windows path: 
[b]%USERPROFILE%/AppData/Local/SomberEchoes/Saved/SaveGames[/b]

Steamdeck/Linux path: [b]home/deck/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/compatdata/1299290/pfx/drive_c/users/steamuser/AppData/Local/SomberEchoes/Saved/SaveGames/[/b]

notes.title: Attention Steam Deck users
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/93da1b2952cccd732aba0004bb7e40cd8c5cc2bd.png[/img]

Due to constructive freedback from Steam Deck users we have done some optimization of the Somber Echoes Demo for the platform. 

After you have downloaded the updated version of the Somber Echoes Demo the game should automatically switch the Steam Deck Mode under Settings > Render and Resolution to ON. If not, you should be able to turn it on manually. 

The Steam Deck Mode will output correct resolution of the screen, set the quality to Medium and lock the framerate to 45 FPS. Also V-sync is recommended for Steam Deck. This should provide a stable player experience. If you prefer the unlocked framerate, you are still free to set change it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/486936deacf0891c0ccbd32cab3fd33f0f829e5b.png[/img]

Thank you!

notes.title: Revealing the Voice Actor for Somber Echoes
notes.notes:
Hi,

I am Melina Spetsieri and I am delighted to announce that I will be the voice of Somber Echoes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/5f2ec97bc577151ca2b8503773b00ace6e57a632.png[/img]

When I was approached by Rock Pocket Games I was immediately drawn into the Greek tragedy aspect of the story, and even more when I learned about the narration. 

It has long been a dream of mine to combine my experience as an actress with my love for video games, and this is the perfect opportunity. 

Somber Echoes isn’t only inspired by the narrative tradition of Greek tragedies, but also the way they were told. 

That is also why Rock Pocket Games were looking for a voice that had certain qualities for the narrator, and I am honored to help bring that to life. 

As a Greek with a love of our history of  storytelling tradition I am proud to join the game creators on this journey. Hope you feel the same way.

I will also participate on a stream where we play the new playtest for Somber Echoes, where I will talk about the game and you can ask me any questions. 

[b]Join me at the Twitch channel: [url=www.twitch.tv/aerosunodos]www.twitch.tv/aerosunodos[/url] on 16th of August at 8PM CET / 11AM PDT[/b]

Cheers, 
Melina

notes.title: It all started in the Cesspit
notes.notes:
The Fracture pulled the space vessel Atromitos into an unknown dimension, opening rifts for terrifying monsters to swarm the ship. All districts aboard the vessel were affected - causing chaos, destruction and despair.

The district called the Cesspit had a profound effect on Harmonia's formative ambition. Initially named The Sewage and Waste Management District, Cesspit was the part of the ship where waste and water were processed and recycled. However - out of necessity it evolved into a makeshift prison. Criminals and “undesirables” for the middle- and upper class were sentenced to forced labor - sometimes, for life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/c2fd94c21b6eed1c5f71f85d1d1dea3e3c4745af.jpg[/img]

This is where Harmonia found her catalyst for ambition - as she started rising the ranks of clergy on the ship, she also showed mercy and care for the lowest class on the vessel. Slowly she gathered a religious following. 

As Harmonia became the Oracle of Atromitos, she intensified her plans to rise up against Aether and Nyx, a hubris-filled path that pushed many of her former allies away from her. But the Cesspit prisoners blindly followed her. She instructed the construction of a massive portal at the bowels of the Cesspit and through it, they summoned unspeakable allies to aid Harmonia in her cause. The monstrous creatures remained obedient because they were afraid of Harmonia but they still turned the sewage pipes into a maze-like insectoid nest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/806e7e407f6749ce25a9229d5d8323f4ddcab2b9.jpg[/img]

Things changed when the Fracture wreaked havoc across the ship. Harmonia’s control over the ship weakened, the creatures became frenzied and sought to satiate their hunger, devouring the unfortunates of the Cesspit.

Attempts to save the ship from the monsters were made. As the Cesspit became a huge nest of unspeakable abominations, the Captain of the Atromito’s guard, Ares, made an attempt to purge it of the monstrosities that had started spilling out of the Cesspit and into the rest of the ship.

In a final attempt, Ares gathered as many hatchlings as possible next to an airlock to eradicate them into space. He failed and his body is still lying where he fell. If you look closely - there are still memos from Aphrodite addressed to her beloved Ares remaining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/921f96105c1a9ae6fdb6578fc2dee571cf104e3a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Breaking: Changing name to Sombrero Geckos
notes.notes:
We have made the somewhat interesting decision to change the name of Somber Echoes to Sombrero Geckos to accommodate the new protagonist - a gecko sporting a sombrero.

- In self-reflection we have found Somber Echoes to be slightly on the moody side, but intense playtesting has shown that a cute lizard with a fun hat throws a much needed “sparkle” to the mix, says Lead Designer Vangelis Kalaitzis.

- It was frustrating to have all these unused jokes that wouldn’t fit in a greek tragedy. To finally be able to use them feels like an intervention from Dionysus himself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/f75c252d3abc9296227ae6efaeaece380828c4aa.jpg[/img]
The rewritten narrative will now see Pete “The Lizard Wizard” as the star in what will be a Greek Comedy Metroidvania, replacing the intendended Greek tragedy.

- We feel that a fun loving protagonist in a contrasting environment adds to the comedy - like the “Ace Ventura of Video games“

Besides the dashing new protagonist, most of the game will stay the same and the intentional release window for late 2024 will stay on target.

- Pete will not only make you laugh, but also move you to tears, says designer Tom-Ivar Arntzen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/21a6fc20ad9be6eaaca46fa42d0ecb5f3dfc7429.gif[/img]

notes.title: Behind the curtain and between the sheets: Volume 1
notes.notes:
Hello fellow video game kids!

We are Rock Pocket Games - a small indie developer in Tonsberg, Norway. For the last couple of years we have been making the Metroidvania known as Somber Echoes. 

A few weeks ago we officially revealed the game and thought it would be cool to provide a small peak behind the curtain of the process.

Somber Echoes takes place on Atromitos - a vast Greco-Roman space vessel in a distant future. A mysterious cataclysm onboard has tainted the once proud spaceship, which is something we are trying to tell in the environments. Stories of “what if the Roman empire survived thousands of years”. 

These shots are just small glimpses of what will be in the game and are work in progress, so will surely change during the development. 

Hopefully this small peak conveys some of what we are trying to create.

notes.title: Greek mythology meets Dead Space in new dark fantasy Metroidvania game
notes.notes:
Somber Echoes is the newly announced sci-fi Metroidvania game from developers Rock Pocket Games and Lav Games. The 2.5D game incorporates many unique characteristics, which takes a bit to digest, as players board a Greco-Roman spaceship and face some truly gross David Cronenberg-type interdimensional baddies along the way. For fans of the genre, Somber Echoes represents a blending of inspiration that infuses aesthetic elements of Dead Space with modern Metroidvania design and gameplay.
